# Commands Build/Run checkout, cache provenance, and freshness status

Authenticated `/api/automatic-build` persists `settings.json` beside dependency-updater state, defaults enabled when absent, and backs the Settings checkbox. Disabling aborts active work and guards awaited boundaries before worktree mutation, Rust check, build, verification, and snapshot publication; enabling forces a compatibility check without cooldown. Existing `~/.tb-tools/daily-build` output is retained but no longer an active scheduler. [Task 5]

Scope: console.
